books.title: From Tomorrow
books.coverAlt: Cover of From Tomorrow: two students on facing railway platforms beneath an orange sunset.
books.blurb: A train line closing in three days. Notes exchanged between two strangers — each dated a day they haven’t lived yet. A story about time, loss, and the moments we almost miss.
books.shortBlurb: Time, loss, and the moments we almost miss.

hook: A train line closing in three days.
Notes from a day she hasn’t lived yet.

books.title: Sakura Slice Café
books.coverAlt: Cover of Sakura Slice Café: a barista, a rabbit, an owl and a fox serving guests in a warm pink café.
books.blurb: Thirteen quiet stories from a café that was never just a café. A place where people arrive carrying something — and leave a little lighter. Your table is already waiting.
books.shortBlurb: Being seen — thirteen quiet stories from the café.

hook: Thirteen quiet stories from a café
that was never just a café.

books.title: The Perfect Sunrise
books.coverAlt: Cover of The Perfect Sunrise: a girl on a shoreline holding a photograph as the sun rises over the sea.
books.blurb: Every morning, Hikari chases the perfect sunrise. Then a photograph falls from the sky — already developed, already perfect, and dated tomorrow. A story about memory, loss, and the people we love who never truly leave.
books.shortBlurb: Memory, loss, and the people who never truly leave.

hook: A photograph falls from the sky —

books.title: When You Were There
books.coverAlt: Cover of When You Were There: two schoolboys on a riverside path at sunset, one listening to a cassette player.
books.blurb: Sou’s grandmother leaves him a cassette tape. When he plays it, he hears his own voice — older, crying, begging someone not to leave. A story about grief, attention, and the one direction time moves in.
books.shortBlurb: Grief, attention, and the one direction time moves in.

hook: On the tape, his own voice —
older, begging someone not to leave.

books.title: The Blue Bookmark Bookshop
books.coverAlt: The cover of The Blue Bookmark Bookshop: a cobalt blue bookshop under cherry blossom, a cat on the step, the title hand-lettered across the sky.
books.blurb: The cat finds you first. He leads you to Aoi Shiori, a little bookshop that wasn’t there yesterday and won’t be there tomorrow. Everyone who finds this place has lost something along the way.
books.shortBlurb: A bookshop that wasn’t there yesterday and won’t be there tomorrow.

hook: You follow, because something already knows.
